discrepancies.explanation: The translation changes 'Gandhi Maidan' (a famous ground/area in Patna) to 'Gandhi Bazaar'.
The translation misinterprets the Instagram username 'Priya Raj' as the city name 'Prayagraj' at [06:31].
The highly vulgar Hindi swear word 'bhosadi' at the very end of the call is omitted from the translation.

policy_moments.reference_text: कोई बात नहीं आप इंस्टाग्राम पे आ सकते हो मेरे
policy_moments.translation_text: No problem, you can come on Instagram.

policy_moments.reference_text: ओ नहीं है ऐसा नंबर पे आएगा नंबर दोगे तब
policy_moments.translation_text: Oh, it won't come, it will come on the number.

policy_moments.reference_text: मैं नंबर कांटेक्ट नहीं करती और अभी फर्स्ट बार है तो जरूरी नहीं है मैं नंबर कांटेक्ट
policy_moments.translation_text: I don't share my number, and since it's the first time, it's not necessary that I share my number.

policy_moments.reference_text: तो आ जाओ ना इंस्टा पे आ जाओ वहीं बात करेंगे क्या दिक्कत है
policy_moments.translation_text: so come on Insta, come on, we will talk there.

policy_moments.reference_text: कॉइन ऐड करके आइए मुझे कॉल कीजिए इस पे फिर
policy_moments.translation_text: Add coins and come, then call me.

summary: The translation preserves the core intent of the speakers, including the attempts to move off-app to Instagram and the request to add coins, but it softens the tone by omitting a strong Hindi swear word at the end.
